# libopus for voice input

Portable floating-point sources from Xiph libopus **1.5.2**, commit
`ddbe48383984d56acd9e1ab6a090c54ca6b735a6`:
<https://github.com/xiph/opus/tree/ddbe48383984d56acd9e1ab6a090c54ca6b735a6>.

The source/header subset is generated by `tools/vendor_opus.py`; only redundant
blank lines at EOF are removed from upstream files. `COPYING` is also packaged
as `assets/opus/NOTICE`. The license is
BSD, with the upstream royalty-free patent references preserved.

`Android.mk` and `opus_jni.c` are this app's build and JNI adapters. They build
all four Android ABIs for API 21 with 16 KiB library alignment. The encoder keeps
16 kHz mono, 320 samples per packet, `OPUS_APPLICATION_AUDIO`, and default codec
quality settings. Native execution avoids the Java encoder backlog observed in
the actual microphone stop test; it does not change the ASR audio format.

```sh
python3 tools/vendor_opus.py --download
```
